summary: Climate change mitigation and carbon emissions reduction are critical issues in many countries. The National Carbon Credit Registry helps countries develop a national registry to track, record, issue, and trade carbon credits, ensuring data integrity and transparency. This open-source toolkit supports countries in fulfilling the requirements of Article 6 (Paris Agreement) and enables carbon credit tracking transactions from mitigation activities. The registry allows countries to customize and deploy their version of the system, linking it to other national and international systems. By reducing costs and ensuring compatibility with existing systems, the registry simplifies the creation of domestic carbon markets. The project's impact is to enhance transparency and facilitate the creation of domestic carbon markets, ultimately contributing to climate change mitigation efforts.
